page.layout: One column of running text on the left; marginal notes in the right margin, beside the lines they belong to; catchword "Ut" below the last line at the right. Printed page number and running head at the top.

main_text.p: enim honoris confervandi gra-tia initum duellum, rationibus superius allegatis, per omnia fuerit improbatum, multo magis illud quod suscipitur armorum ereptorum gratiâ. Neque enim unquam in rei veri-tate nobis periit fama, aut ademptus familiæ splendor, si quis armis nostris fuerit abu-sus. Præterquam quod si hic læsa sit existumatio,diff Chaf-san. Ca-[?]al Glor. mund.p. 35. ea publico judicio, publicis legibus reparari possit. Ideo enim constitutiones à Principibus sunt emissæ,Const. Philipp. 2.de ann. 1591. 23. quibus pœna statuitur in eos,Sept. Al. bert & Isabell de ann.16[?] qui non propriis utun-tur armis, vel nobilitatem prę-tendunt, quam non habent. Ideo etiam armorum Præfe-ctis,Jan. 7. libr. Const. & Principibus, quos He-raldos appellant incumbit officii nomine,Brabant & Flandr. 1. part. ut in singulorum insignia inquirant,tit. 4. & si quem non suo usum fuisse appareat,libr. 1. e. 1. 2. 3. in eum animadverti curent.

page.notes: Catchword "Ut" is at the foot right and is not repeated in the text. The marginal note "tal/ral" after "Chaf-san. Ca-" is doubtful and marked [?]. The year in "ann.16" is cut off at the edge of the scan and is marked [?]. Some note lines are close together, so the exact line to which each note belongs is approximate.
